svg.text: SkillCanary - red, then green
$ skillcanary gate examples/change.bad.json examples/cases.json
! pre-change gate only: add evidence before/after the run
x expected_transition must be "FAIL->PASS" for target.kind=case
x reason must explain the change in at least 20 characters
x decision must explain the change in at least 20 characters
x production_change must be true/false
x prediction.fix must be a non-empty array
x prediction.regress_risk must be a non-empty array
x budget.repeat must be at least 3
x target case "missing-case" does not exist in cases
Result: FAIL (exit 1)
$ skillcanary gate examples/change.good.json examples/cases.json
Result: PASS (exit 0)
$ <the same change, with reason shortened by one field>
x reason must explain the change in at least 20 characters
Result: FAIL (exit 1)
$ skillcanary anchor <skill> --check (one reference file changed)
x changed: references/guide.md
Result: DRIFT 1 (exit undefined)
same case - pass only while the change can prove what it fixed
Reproduce: npm run demo:case
